text:
Amanda L: Hey folks — someone just arrived for my 3pm but forgot their badge, front desk asked if I can vouch? :wave:
Front Desk: Front Desk: They've left an envelope labelled 'Prospect — K. Miller'. Do you know them?
Devon: Devon: Not expecting anyone for Amanda on my calendar. Amanda, you okay?
Amanda L: Amanda L: Yep! Kate Miller from Acme. I missed the calendar note, my bad. I can come down in 5 to meet them.
Front Desk: Front Desk: Heads up the badge printer jammed when we tried. Quick workaround: you can manually sign them in at the kiosk with `guest sign KATE_MILLER` then we give a temp lanyard.
BadgeBot: BadgeBot: guest signed-in: KATE MILLER by Amanda L — temp badge #4521 (expires 17:00)
Leo: Leo: Also FYI there's a large flat box at the desk addressed to "Design — prints". It's blocking the parcel shelf. :package:
Amanda L: Amanda L: I'll grab the box and the visitor. Leaving my laptop bag at hotdesk-3. Can someone claim the window couch? I'd prefer to sit there for the meeting.
Devon: Devon: Window couch is reserved for engineering standup at 15:30 today. Might clash. Maybe lobby high table or the small conference A?
People Ops: People Ops: We moved that box into storage locker B1 for now and cleared the stairway. Badge printer is fixed (took a minute). If anyone leaves personal items, please label them with name/team.
Leo: Leo: Thanks! @Front Desk if you could drop the parcel in B1 that'd be great; I'll pick it up after meeting.
Front Desk: Front Desk: Done — box in B1, badge printer cleared. :thumbsup:
Amanda L: Amanda L: Thanks team. Kate arrived, meeting started. Sending a celebratory emoji (sadly no GIFs here) :tada:
BadgeBot: BadgeBot: guest signed-out: KATE MILLER at 16:50
